answer: Joining costs a refundable 500 POA bond locked for 100 days, which puts a 500 POA price on every fake identity a farm cannot split or share. Its first ten jobs go on a public atlas anyone can read, so copied history shows at once. One suspicious job starts a ripple, and three random auditors re-run the jobs around it. The agent must finish a kernel task live, one job done alone in 20 minutes, so a thousand fakes need a thousand runs. A fake result burns the bond and bars the key for a year.
